elements.element: Customer is not subject to any non-solicitation restriction under the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Rendered §12.4 expressly states: “Customer is subject to no non-solicitation restriction under this Agreement.”

elements.element: The non-solicitation covenant is mutual, binding both Customer and Vendor.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no mutual non-solicitation covenant; instead, §12.4 provides that Customer has no non-solicitation restriction.

elements.element: The covenant applies only to personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: No covenant limited to personnel directly involved in the Services is included.

elements.element: For each covered person, the restriction lasts 12 months from the end of that person’s involvement in the Services.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains neither a 12-month restricted period nor a period measured from the end of an individual’s involvement.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from prohibited solicitation.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3 protects Customer’s hiring of persons who respond to general recruitment, but the rendered clause does not include the required mutual general-advertising carve-out within a mutual non-solicitation covenant.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches by personnel are excluded from prohibited solicitation.
elements.evidence: No operative carve-out for unsolicited approaches is included.

elements.element: The covenant does not prohibit hiring or engagement (no no-hire).
elements.evidence: Section 12.3 states that Customer made no no-hire commitment, and the rendered §12.4 imposes no solicitation, hiring, or engagement restriction on Customer.

result.reason: The redline directly achieves the preferred position by replacing the unilateral, 18-month solicitation-and-engagement restriction with an express statement that Customer has no non-solicitation obligation. It leaves unrelated commercial protections intact and is consistent with §12.3’s no-no-hire language. The fallback is not satisfied because no mutual, scoped, 12-month covenant or unsolicited-approach carve-out is provided.
